harness.invocation: claude -p <prompt> --model <model> --output-format stream-json --verbose --tools Bash --setting-sources project --disable-slash-commands --strict-mcp-config --no-session-persistence --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools "Bash(neo4j-cli:*)" "Bash(head:*)" "Bash(tail:*)" "Bash(jq:*)" "Bash(wc:*)" --max-budget-usd 2 --append-system-prompt <allowlist notice>
harness.agent_shell_scope: dontAsk plus allowlist, so the agent cannot read the real HOME (a first T6 run read shell history and leaked a credential; scrubbed)
harness.neo4j_cli_isolation: PATH wrapper sets HOME=<run>/home before exec of the pinned binary; the agent's own HOME is untouched
harness.docker: T7 only: the PATH wrapper sets DOCKER_HOST to the Docker Desktop socket (~/.docker/run/docker.sock), because the throwaway HOME hides the docker context. The agent shell still cannot run docker itself. Leftover managed containers fail the check and are removed after the run.
harness.arms: --bin PATH --arm LABEL runs the same tasks against another build (for example a card's parent and changed builds). Results go to bench/results/<arm>/. The default arm is the pinned release.
harness.tasks_file: bench/tasks.json holds every prompt. expectedAnswer must appear as a whole word of the final answer; mustRun lists commands the agent must have run. State checks live in run.py.

aura.credential_source: AURA_CLIENT_ID and AURA_CLIENT_SECRET, read from the environment or ~/.config/aura/env. The runner seeds them into the throwaway HOME for tasks marked "aura": true in tasks.json, and removes them from the environment of the claude process. The agent never sees the secret.

billing: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (API billing); cost_usd in results is the reported total_cost_usd
notes: T1-T7 frozen. T8-T10 need an Aura key.
Success checks: expectedAnswer and mustRun in tasks.json, state checks in run.py.
Fixtures use credential-storage insecure under a throwaway HOME.
T7 needs Docker running and the neo4j:community image pulled beforehand (pull time is not part of the run).
Decision rule: a build is better only on a material tool_output_bytes drop with success held. A cheaper arm that answers wrong loses. Report other changes as non-wins.
metrics: tool_output_bytes (sum of Bash tool_result bytes the agent read back)
